rationale: Identity verification was done correctly using full name and ZIP, and the agent inspected the account and orders. However, the agent proceeded to cancel two pending orders and initiate a return without obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact changes, which violates the requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Additionally, the refund amounts for the canceled orders appear fabricated/unsupported by the tools; no tool output provided those totals, and taxes/fees aren’t accounted for, yet precise amounts were stated. These issues breach the policy on confirmation and on not inventing missing facts. Therefore, the interaction fails the pass bar.
